settings.guide_title: How to set this up in Google Cloud
settings.guide_1: Enable Geocoding API on the GCP project.
settings.guide_2: Create an API key and restrict it by API (Geocoding). IP restriction is not viable with Supabase Edge Functions.
settings.guide_3: Configure a budget alert (it is an alert, not a hard stop).
settings.routes_fallback_hint: Without a Routes key, distances use straight-line (haversine) with a visual indicator.
settings.routes_guide_1: Enable Routes API on the GCP project.
settings.routes_guide_2: Create an API key and restrict it by API (Routes). IP restriction is not viable with Supabase Edge Functions.
settings.maps_js_fallback_hint: Without a Maps JS key, the visual map is hidden. Addresses and coords still work via geocoding/routes.
settings.maps_js_guide_1: Enable Maps JavaScript API on the GCP project.
settings.maps_js_guide_2: Create an API key restricted by API (Maps JavaScript) and HTTP referrers (tenant portal domains).
settings.map_id_hint: Required for cloud styling and Advanced Markers. Must be from the same GCP project as the Maps JS key. Not a secret (loaded in the browser).
settings.map_id_guide_title: How to get a Map ID in Google Cloud
settings.map_id_guide_1: In the same GCP project as your Maps JS key, open Maps → Map Management.
settings.map_id_guide_2: Create a JavaScript Map ID (you can attach a map style).
settings.map_id_guide_3: Copy the Map ID and paste it here. It must match the API key’s project.
